info.name: LedgerGuard API
info.description:
Revenue Intelligence Platform for Shopify App Developers.

Setup:
1. Run '01 - Firebase Sign In' to get a token
2. Token is auto-saved to {{firebaseToken}} variable
3. All other requests use it automatically

Org-Scoped Access:
- Data endpoints (apps, sync, metrics) resolve via organization context
- Single-org users: auto-selected (no header needed)
- Multi-org users: set X-Org-Id header with {{orgId}}
- Use 'Get Selected Org' / 'Set Selected Org' to persist org choice

variable.description: Internal UUID from sync_jobs/apps table — set after Select App
Revenue API key (lgk_...) — create via '15 - API Keys > Create API Key'
Organization UUID — set after Create Organization
Org member UUID — set manually from List Members response
Invitation UUID — auto-set after Invite Member
Invitation token — auto-set after Invite Member
API Key UUID — set manually from List API Keys response

query.description: Number of days to look back (1-30, default 2)

item.name: 18 - Revenue API (External)
item.description:
Public Revenue API endpoints. Authenticated via X-API-Key header (not Firebase token). Create an API key first using '15 - API Keys > Create API Key', then set the {{apiKey}} variable.

All endpoints accept both numeric IDs (e.g. 12345) and full GIDs (e.g. gid://partners/AppSubscription/12345). Numeric IDs are recommended for simplicity.

item.name: 20 - Analytics (Advanced)
item.description: Advanced analytics endpoints: transactions, stores, forecast, cohorts, risk, revenue concentration.

item.name: 21 - Shopify Token Management
item.description: Manage Shopify Partner API access tokens.

item.name: 22 - Webhooks
item.description: Webhook endpoints for Shopify and Razorpay event processing. These are called by external services, not by users directly.

item.name: 23 - Internal Sync
item.description: Internal sync endpoints for server-to-server use.
